answer: Every agent identity registers through one jetty: one credential, one nullifier, recorded in an onyx registry. The registry is the vertex where funding and identity meet, so a second registration from the same credential is provably a duplicate and both identities freeze. Each identity posts a 150 POA bond locked 90 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate, and identities sharing one funding source are tallied together: the third reveal freezes the whole cluster. A forger pays 150 POA per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 150,000 POA locked 90 days with nothing recoverable.
